oracle.statement: GET /telemetry answers 200 with envelope status:string, time:number, result:object; at details_level=10 result contains ALL 9 documented sections id/app/collections/cluster/requests/memory/hardware/search_pool/quota and result.id is a string (a missing section or non-string id = Type4_StateLogicViolation; 4xx on the default read = Type1_IllegalRejection; 5xx with /healthz alive = Type3_RuntimeFailure) (constraint qdrant_type_telemetry_001)
